analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see stance. RSI remains in the low 40s, failing to break out of the neutral zone, and while the MACD histogram shows improvement, a confirmed golden cross is still lacking. The volume ratio of 0.61 indicates weak buying interest. The 5-day volatility sequence (+2.32%, +2.68%, -2.65%, -8.26%, +4.63%) shows a lack of clear direction.

· SMA100(40,920원) 및 SMA200(32,064원) 대비 하회 — 중장기 추세 약세.
· 52주 위치(45.2%) + 현 가격대 역사적 저점 구간 근접.
[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (42.1→43.0) + 중립 구간 지속 중 — 과매도 탈출 신호 미약.
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-91.8217→354.8646) + 개선 진단 — 추세 전환 신호는 아직 미확인.
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치(중단 33,686원 근처) + 밴드폭(43.67%) 넓음 — 변동성 확대 가능성.
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 (29,075원) + 피벗 지지선(S1: 23,712원) 기반.
· 스윙 저항선 (35,220원) + 돌파 시 52주 고가 향한 상승 가능성.
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보) + 추세 방향성 부재.
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.61배) + 움직임의 신뢰도 위축.
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 매수 진입은 MACD 골든크로스 및 RSI 50 이상 회복 확인 후.
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($31,800) above SMA5 ($31,628), below SMA20 ($33,686) — indicating weakening short-term upward momentum and trading below the mid-term trend.
· Below SMA100 ($40,920) and SMA200 ($32,064) — suggesting a weak long-term trend.
· 52-week position (45.2%) + current price level approaching historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.1→43.0) + staying in the neutral zone — weak signal for exiting oversold territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-91.8217→354.8646) + improving diagnosis — trend reversal signal not yet confirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near middle band $33,686) + wide band width (43.67%) — potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support line ($29,075) + based on pivot support (S1: $23,712).
· Swing resistance line ($35,220) + potential for upward movement towards 52-week highs if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) + lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.61x) + reduced reliability of price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation phase) + buy entry contingent on MACD golden cross and RSI recovery above 50.
